items.title: Just Penelope Announce Debut EP Great Lake: Hear “After”
items.summary: Fire Talk's Angel Tapes imprint is a reliable source of promising acts, like Shower Curtain and Sleeper's Bell. Bloomington's Just Penelope are the newest signees, and their explosive, catchy brand of shoegaze is instantly enticing, or at least it is on today's single "After" from their just-announced debut EP Great Lake.

items.title: Jim James – “Wowed Out”
items.summary: My Morning Jacket's Jim James will soon be gracing us with his first solo album in eight years. The good Mr. Olliges announced Wowed Out in June and shared its pounding, soulful, psychedelic hymn "Come Again." Today he's back with the title track, which keeps the shimmering keyboard sounds and utopian language flowing. The post Jim James – “Wowed Out” appeared first on Stereogum.
